name: Roxy Lalonde
source:
Roxy Lalonde is one of the four Alpha kids. [spoiler]She is the post-scratch incarnation of Rose Lalonde's mother.[/spoiler]

She is casual, fun-loving, and sociable. She does not shy away from cursing, and use sexual terms often. She has a particular interest in wizards, video games, and cats. She always has her friends' best interests at heart. She is a very good listener, and often helps her friends work through internal (and external) issues they are struggling with. Being a Rogue, she also has a penchant for minor acts of thievery and has experienced struggles with alcoholism.

[From [url=https://mspaintadventures.fandom.com/wiki/Roxy_Lalonde]MSPA Wiki[/url]]
